explanation: For λ=0, the boundary conditions force y=0. For λ>0, y=A cos(6λx)+B sin(6λx), and y'(0)=0 forces B=0. Nonzero solutions require cos(18λ)=0, so λ_n=(2n+1)π/36 for n=0,1,2,… . The associated eigenfunctions are B_n cos(6λ_n x), with B_n≠0. This uses the indexing convention in which natural numbers include zero.
